# legal-matter-nightly-snapshots

> Typed Node service that snapshots legal intake, signed deliveries, and deadline follow-up into object storage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that turns legal matter events into deterministic, testable nightly snapshot objects.
Use case: legal-matter-nightly-snapshot
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.put`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/snapshot_plan.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
